subject: Help with SIAR package for stable isotope analysis in R?

messages.author: 552a1a29c85bf67e
messages.subject: Help with SIAR package for stable isotope analysis in R?
parts:
Hi all,

Is there anyone out there who has used the SIAR package (Stable Isotope Analysis in R) to run Bayesian isotope mixing models for ecological studies? If so, I would be so appreciative if you could help me with the following question:

I need to use two separate data files for TEF values for my data, one for each tissue type used in my study. However, I use tissue type as a grouping variable such that for each run of the model I can enter all of my data points and compare carbon values to reference samples in each group (in this case, group 1=breath, group 2=wing tissue). Since I can only reference one TEF file per model and I need to refer to two TEF files,  I'm a bit stumped. I need to have at least one grouping category per model run, so if I separate the tissue types into two models I'd have to group by something else, such as site, which I don't necessarily want to do. Would it be inaccurate to run the model twice, once with each TEF file, and extract results pertaining to the appropriate tissue type each time (i.e. run the model with the TEF values for tissue and report tissue results and ignore breath results, then run the model with the TEF values for breath and ignore tissue results)?

If anyone has used the package but the above summarized description isn't clear I'd love to chat more and possibly send you the data files to which I am referring.

Thanks so much in advance!
Jackie

--
Jaclyn Aliperti
Graduate Group in Ecology
University of California, Davis

messages.subject: Re: [D-RUG]: Help with SIAR package for stable isotope analysis in R?
parts:
I have never used this package, nor am i familiar with it so cum grano salis.

It seems to me that you need to join your data in some way. If you have two files that have rows of data (one file per tissue), you can add your tissue to each dataset as a column and then rbind them together. Unless I'm really not understanding your issue.

Why do you "need to use two separate files"?
